description: Six inverters: each output is the opposite of the level at its own input.

inputs.text: The input to one of the six inverters; that inverter's output goes to the opposite level.

outputs.text: 10V while that inverter's input is low, 0V while it is high.

notes: A logic input counts as high once it rises above 2V and does not count as low again until it falls below 0.1V; a logic output is 10V for high and 0V for low.
